set_aside.subject: serve_kernel: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY]
set_aside.text: serve_kernel: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] The entrance is the standard library's http.server.HTTPServer, which serves one request at a time, never a threading or forking server; the surface imports nothing outside the CPython 3.12 standard library except BaseModel from pydantic, the one third-party package, pinned by the release in the imported RELEASE_PYTHON_DEPENDENCIES constant, on which the models and the store repository are emitted and which the surface uses to recognise and serialise models (60_contracts.md decisions 22, 25 and 27).
set_aside.other_text: from cabinet_kernel.data_provider import LISTABLE_RECORD_TYPES, MCP_CATALOGUE_OPERATIONS, MCP_ENDPOINT_PATH, MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION, MCP_SERVER_NAME, MCP_SERVER_VERSION, MCP_TOOL_INPUT_SCHEMAS, PAGE_FILTERS, RELEASE_CEILING_BOUNDED_TEXT_BYTES_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_IMPLEMENTATION_CODE_BYTES_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_JSON_DEPTH_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT, RELEASE_CEILING_PAGE_SIZE_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_SURFACE_REQUEST_BYTES_MAX, RELEASE_CEILING_TRIAL_FIXTURE_BYTES_MAX
